EmailTemplate.subject: Register Now [Free Webinar]: "Inner Game of Prospecting: How to Overcome Sales Call Reluctance" with Connie Kadansky (hosted by EverQuote)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Lead.FirstName}, Sales call reluctance can be devastating to insurance producers. Join sales trainer and sales call reluctance expert Connie Kadansky on Thursday, July 16, 2020 @ 2:00 PM Eastern (11:00 AM Pacific) for a webinar presentation: "Inner Game of Prospecting: How to Overcome Sales Call Reluctance." Connie will cover ways you can identify and work to eliminate Sales Call Reluctance, one of the most critical challenges for salespeople in the insurance industry.
Sales trainer Connie Kadansky has had articles published in The Advisor Today, was a speaker at MDRT, and the NAIFA national conference. She has been interviewed by the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg Business, Inc., Forbes and Investor’s Business Daily. You can sign-up for the free webinar directly through our link here!
Best,
Dennis
